text:
Priya Rao: Quick heads-up — replay harness p99 is ~18% worse than synthetic traffic for the same model+seed on the new cluster. Investigating env parity now.
Ken Park: Can you paste the exact loadtest commands + docker images used?
Priya Rao: Running two runs: synthetic (rps=400, seq=512) and replay (from prod-traces, same rps). Commands:
```bash
# synthetic
./run_loadtest --mode synthetic --model redwood-v2 --rps 400 --seq 512 --image redwood/inference:2026-03-10
# replay
./run_loadtest --mode replay --trace s3://replay/2026-03-08/seg-12.json --rps 400 --image redwood/inference:2026-03-10
```
Priya Rao: Node details (both clusters claim identical):
- GPU: A100-SXM4 80GB
- CUDA: 12.1
- Driver: 535.54
- Container runtime: runc 1.1.8
- Kernel flags: transparent_hugepage=never
- kernel image: ubuntu:22.04 base
Alice Liu: What about the micro-configs? env vars, kernel selector flags, and LD_PRELOADs?
Priya Rao: Good call. Replay cluster had an extra env var we forgot to note: INFERENCE_KV_CACHE=off for the replay nodes (legacy config). Synthetic cluster had it on. Oops.
Ken Park: That could explain more cache misses and longer decode loops. Can you repro with toggling that flag?
Priya Rao: Did a quick flip — enabling KV cache on replay nodes moves p99 down ~12% (not all the way). So KV is a big part but still residual delta ~6%.
Jorge M: Any driver/cuda subtlety? I've seen 535.x patch differences cause kernel selection to prefer 16-bit epilogue kernels which sometimes increase warp divergence on long seqs. Are both nodes reporting identical cuDNN/cuBLAS versions?
Priya Rao: I pulled package manifests: replay nodes have libcudnn 8.9.2, synthetic has 8.9.1 — small patch diff. Also the replay image has an extra build arg that enabled a custom fused-attn kernel (env: USE_FUSED_ATTN=1). Synthetic did not.
Alice Liu: That sounds promising — fused-attn can change kernel timing and memory pressure. Do you have a profiling snapshot? small perf trace or nvprof?
Priya Rao: Attached a short perf dump (sanitized) — pasted relevant lines:
```text
[profile-start] model=redwood-v2 seq=512 mode=replay
kernel: matmul_ft: avg 0.42ms p99 1.8ms 
kernel: fused_attn_forward: avg 0.95ms p99 4.2ms 
KV cache ops: miss-rate 17% 
[profile-end]
[profile-start] model=redwood-v2 seq=512 mode=synthetic
kernel: matmul_ft: avg 0.39ms p99 1.1ms 
kernel: attn_block: avg 0.65ms p99 1.5ms 
KV cache ops: miss-rate 3%
[profile-end]
```
Priya Rao: Notice fused_attn p99 spikes during replay.
Ken Park: That matches the hypothesis: fused_attn implementation here seems to have non-deterministic latency on irregular input lengths from replay traces. Synthetic uses padded fixed-length batches so attn_block wins.
Alice Liu: Action items: 1) Re-run replay with USE_FUSED_ATTN=0, KV cache=on on a single node; 2) Collect nvprof+nsys for the slow periods; 3) Check cuDNN minor versions across images.
Priya Rao: Doing 1 now. Kickoff logs: deploy-bot started canary on node rtx-r1.
perf-bot: scheduled loadtest job 2026-03-03T15:22Z -> job 98732 (canary)
Priya Rao: Quick result from canary (single node): toggling fused_attn=0 drops p99 by 7% and combined with KV cache=on we match synthetic within noise (~1.5%). So fused_attn + KV off were the big culprits.
Jorge M: Good. But we should also capture an apples-to-apples kernel selection table so we don't regress again. Propose: add env check to loadtest harness that asserts identical runtime flags (USE_FUSED_ATTN, INFERENCE_KV_CACHE, CUDA/cuDNN versions, LD_PRELOAD) and fail the run if mismatch.
Ken Park: Agree. Also add a small probe at the start that runs a micro-benchmark to detect whether the fused kernel path is chosen (quick 3-step probe).
Alice Liu: For longer term: we should make fused_attn opt-in per model via model manifest, not per image flag — avoids accidental flips during image rebuilds. Also add a note to release checklist about driver/cuDNN pinned combos for our official load labs.
Priya Rao: I'll open a follow-up PR: 1) loadtest harness parity checks, 2) probe + telemetry to record chosen kernels per run, 3) document canonical driver/cuDNN matrix.
Ken Park: Please include a short repro in the PR that runs the two micro-benchmarks and shows kernel names from nvtx.
Priya Rao: Will do. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Alice Liu: Nice root cause hunt. One more ask — can we add a small regression test in CI that runs a 30s replay vs synthetic and asserts p99 ratio < 1.12? Might be flaky but worth a try behind a toggle.
Priya Rao: Agree, I'll add behind a flaky toggle and run nightly first.
Ken Park: Closing loop: update eng-runbook and ping security if we lock cuDNN versions for prod images.
Priya Rao: Done, PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/inference/pulls/4128 (description + perf diffs).
perf-bot: job 98732 completed — artifacts uploaded to s3://perf-artifacts/98732/
Priya Rao: Uploaded nvprof + nsys traces in the PR artifacts. Thanks everyone.
